meta.description: Character LoRA on FLUX.2 Klein 4B (gated on HF — accept the licence). UNVERIFIED: ported from LDS's built-in, itself extrapolated from generic subject guidance (rank 16/16 family default, sigmoid timesteps NOT Klein-verified). For the 9B: arch flux2_klein_9b + black-forest-labs/FLUX.2-klein-base-9B (needs ~32-48 GB VRAM). Steps: LDS computes ~120/image clamped [1500,3500]. automagic3 variant: the LR above is a launch point, not a target - the optimizer adapts one LR per param group from gradient sign consensus, so no scheduler is needed. min_lr/max_lr rail it (max_lr = this preset's own LR, so it can only adapt downward). Gradient accumulation MUST stay 1 unless you also set optimizer_params.fused=false: fused automagic steps every micro-batch and the trainer hard-errors at config parse otherwise. UNVERIFIED for this arch - automagic3 has no published per-arch data; Krea 2 is the only arch in this fork with a real measured run. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged.
